summary: Signed installer, corrected licensing: one 7-day in-app Pro trial, then Free unless an active Patreon membership applies.
notes: The installer is code-signed and timestamped.
Every installation gets one 7-day in-app Pro trial with a visible countdown; when it ends CouchMode returns to Free.
Pro access comes only from an active Patreon membership: Pro Version is $3/month for up to 2 active Windows devices, Pro Supporter is $5/month for up to 5.
A connected Patreon account without a qualifying tier no longer grants Pro.
Disconnect Patreon from this PC now completes even when the licensing service cannot be reached.
Connecting Patreon works out of the box on beta builds.
Patreon status messages describe the membership only, and no longer imply that your CouchMode licence expired.
If your device limit drops, the extra devices are released automatically instead of staying active.
knownIssues: Devices can only be released from the PC they are on; there is no in-app option to sign out of all devices.
Xbox full-screen availability depends on your Windows version, device support, region, and Microsoft rollout status.

summary: Report sending, update checks, calmer Xbox full-screen unavailable state, and CouchMode branding updates.
notes: Report a problem can send user-approved reports.
Xbox full-screen unavailable state is calmer and persistent.
